note: Public-domain Hawaiian / hapa-haole tunes Embry hums (she loves the old kitschy Hawaiian sound). ALL picks are compositions published 1930 or earlier -> US public domain as of 2026 (Duke CSPD, verified). The beloved 1930s film-era hits (Sweet Leilani 1937, My Little Grass Shack 1933, Blue Hawaii 1937) are NOT yet PD and are excluded until their year. Hum the ORIGINAL melody only, never a modern copyrighted arrangement (esp. Hawaiian War Chant: 1860s Leleiohoku melody is PD; the 1936 Johnny Noble arrangement is not). Recognizability caveat: ElevenLabs SFX humming is non-lexical and note-approximate, so a clip evokes the STYLE/mood, not a note-accurate rendition (which also keeps it doubly clear of the melody copyright). Clips stored on the 12TB drive; persona_memory holds the taste facts + metadata for semantic (text_mm) recall by mood/tempo/category.
